jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
Att jobba som . NET utvecklare

Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.

Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:

Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk & Hälsa.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.

Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.

Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos några av regionens mest intressanta kunder. I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Vi vill gärna komma i kontakt med dig som är nyfiken på HiQ och öppen för nya utmaningar. Genom att lära känna dig, din kompetens och dina drivkrafter kan vi tillsammans hitta ett sammanhang där du kan utvecklas och göra skillnad.

👉 Skicka in din ansökan och berätta mer om dig själv. När din kompetens möter rätt uppdrag kan det bli starten på något riktigt bra!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla – oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv. Hoppas vi hörs i höst!

jobs.title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.

We're looking for an experienced AI-First Senior Software Engineer
for our Stockholm office.

This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software engineers , not software developers . AI has hyper-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.

Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and sustainable software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

What You'll Do

System design. Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
Domain modelling. Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the right solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
Architectural patterns. Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
Process design — the core responsibility. Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as orchestrator–worker (an orchestrator decides sub-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and evaluator–optimizer (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
Quality judgment. Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line-by-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
Tooling — the right tool for the job. Fluency across product-development tools, AI-acceleration (code-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
Accountability. You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

Your profile

8+ years of hands-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
An early adopter of AI-first development, with proven, in-production experience implementing AI-first software development processes — not just experimenting with tooling
Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow-vs-agent decisions)
Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
Test design, feedback-loop design and validation skills over line-by-line review
Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI-accelerated pipelines
Infrastructure / CI-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
Domain-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Tools you'll work with

AI-acceleration: Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
Languages & engineering: .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code-review practice
Workflow orchestration: agent frameworks and multi-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
Infrastructure: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
Quality control: automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI-assisted output

Meritorious

Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
Experience standing up AI-first processes at team or organisation scale
LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience

What this role is not

It is not a prompt-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase less reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail-over and redundancy, because AI burn-out is real)
Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

With us you get

A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

Selected benefits

Competitive fixed salary
30 days holiday
Company laptop, phone and subscription

Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.

Engineering judgement, accelerated — that's how we make IT easy.

jobs.description:
Start date: 2026-11-01

End date: 2027-01-31

Scope: 100 %, full-time

Location: Stockholm or Helsinki, on-site 2-3 days a week

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect to help shape the future of banking technology. You will lead the architecture of domain-oriented data products and APIs that enable critical business capabilities across the bank.

Working at the intersection of business, technology and data, you will partner with architects, engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders to create scalable, secure and resilient solutions. You will provide end-to-end architectural leadership across multiple delivery streams, while enabling teams to make effective decisions within clear architectural guardrails.

Your impact

You will establish reusable data and API capabilities that accelerate delivery, improve interoperability and create value for customers and business partners.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead architecture across domains

Define and evolve the architecture vision, principles and roadmap for Data Products and Domain APIs.
Align business capabilities, data assets, APIs and technology platforms across multiple delivery streams.
Oversee the end-to-end solution architecture and coordinate the work of software architects embedded in individual delivery streams.
Identify interfaces, data flows and cross-domain dependencies, and guide teams in evaluating solution alternatives.

Drive data product excellence

Establish patterns and standards for domain-owned data products that are discoverable, trustworthy, reusable and governed.
Clarify data ownership, product boundaries, quality expectations, metadata, lineage and lifecycle responsibilities.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to maximise the value and safe use of data across the organisation.
Promote modern data architecture practices, including data product thinking and domain ownership.

Shape the domain API landscape

Define API-first architecture principles, design standards, governance and lifecycle management practices.
Guide the definition of domain boundaries, API contracts, versioning, security and reusable integration patterns.
Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, resilient, observable and easy for consumers to use.
Support event-driven and service-oriented integration approaches where they provide clear business and technology value.

Build resilient, delivery-ready solutions

Define solution-level functional requirements and non-functional requirements for availability, performance, security, scalability, resilience and operability.
Define subsystems and interfaces, allocate responsibilities and clarify interactions with the wider solution context.
Build and maintain the architectural runway needed for sustainable delivery and future change.
Enable Continuous Delivery and DevOps through pragmatic design guidelines, automation and investment advocacy.

Collaborate and influence

Work closely with Product and Solution Management, business stakeholders, engineering teams, Enterprise Architects and external suppliers.
Contribute architectural expertise to planning, high-level design, solution demonstrations and continuous exploration.
Help shape and realise architectural enablers, including appropriate capacity allocation for enablement work.
Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor architects and engineering teams, foster collaboration and enable decentralised decision-making.

Experience and domain knowledge

Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a comparable senior architecture role.

A proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, API and integration solutions.

Experience leading architecture across multiple teams, products or technology domains.

A strong understanding of banking technology and business processes. Experience with Core Banking platforms is highly desirable.

Experience working in complex, regulated environments with demanding security, resilience and data governance requirements.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.

We're now expanding our AI & Workflow Automation practice and are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
for our Stockholm office.

A Forward Deployed Engineer works inside the client organisation — not at arm's length. You sit with their teams, learn how the business actually runs, and turn AI from a proof-of-concept into a trusted, working part of daily operations. This is the role at the centre of AI and workflow automation at Nion: the person who takes an ambition to "use AI" and produces something that delivers measurable value.

The hardest part of AI isn't the demo — it's the gap between a clever prototype and a secure process people actually use every day. Closing that gap is what this role is about.

What You'll Do

Every Nion FDE brings four core skills, and you'll work across all of them:

Analysis — finding where AI and automation genuinely create value, and where they don't.
Process definition — designing the new, AI-first way of working before any tool is deployed.
Implementation — building, integrating and hardening agents, models and automations into the client's live environment.
Adoption — making it stick through enablement, change and handover, so the value outlasts the engagement.

You'll own outcomes end-to-end: discovery and workflow mapping, solution design, hands-on implementation with AI tooling, and the change work that gets people using it. Throughout, you account for business value, AI sovereignty, AI spend, governance and compliance — GDPR and the EU AI Act built in, not bolted on.

Your profile

Minimum 5 years in a delivery, consulting or solutions role where you've taken automation or AI solutions from discovery to production in real business environments
Strong process analysis and design skills — mapping workflows, quantifying value, and redesigning how work gets done
Hands-on experience implementing LLM-based and agentic solutions (prompt engineering, RAG patterns, multi-step/agent workflows, tool use)
Practical command of modern AI tooling and automation platforms (examples below)
Comfortable integrating AI into business systems via APIs and connectors
Experience driving adoption — enablement, stakeholder management, training and handover
Solid understanding of data protection, security and AI governance (GDPR, EU AI Act)
Confident working embedded in client teams and translating between business and technical stakeholders
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

This is not
a deep software-engineering role. We're looking for someone who builds working solutions with AI tooling and integration — not someone writing large custom codebases from scratch. Comfort with light scripting (e.g. Python) to glue things together is expected, but the emphasis is on process, tooling and implementation.

Tools you'll work with

LLM platforms: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Watson.X
Agent & orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen or similar
Workflow & automation platforms: n8n, Make, Power Automate, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS / low-code tools
RAG & retrieval: vector databases and embedding models (working knowledge)
Integration: REST APIs, webhooks, connectors to business systems
Supporting: Python for scripting/glue, Git, basic containerisation (Docker)

Meritorious

Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience
Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
Experience with LLM evaluation, testing and guardrails
Familiarity with agile ways of working

We're looking for someone who is

Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
Communicative and a team player who's comfortable embedded with clients
Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

With us you get

A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

Selected benefits

Opportunity for part-ownership
Competitive fixed salary
30 days holiday
Company laptop, phone and subscription

Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.

We make AI work in the real world — that's Sustainable Acceleration, delivered by people, not slides.

jobs.title: Principal Data Architect
jobs.description:
emagine is looking for: Principal Data Architect – Group Information Model and Data Architecture

emagine is looking for a Principal Data Architect for our client in the financial and information services sector. The client operates across four Nordic markets and is at the start of a multi-year transformation. Data from Oracle, Db2 and mainframe environments will be consolidated into a governed operational data platform on AWS, while existing systems continue to support the business.

This is the most senior architectural role in the programme. You will own the Group information model, domain model and data architecture. The core challenge is to distinguish genuine business differences between markets from historical inconsistencies, and to build a common model that endures regardless of technology choices. The programme is deliberately small: existing staff supported by a handful of senior specialists.

Responsibilities

Define the Group information model: common business concepts, entities and relationships, and where local variation is required.
Own the domain model, including bounded contexts, context maps, shared language and service boundaries based on DDD. The model is implemented through versioned data contracts, semantic models and domain services.
Introduce anti-corruption layers between new domain contracts and legacy systems of record.
Define how the model, governance and data contracts are implemented on the operational data platform, and contribute to platform decisions.
Design the migration architecture, covering patterns, reconciliation, dependency sequencing and acceptance criteria for a gradual transition without a big-bang cutover.
Design data governance: classification, lineage, information ownership, retention, access control and country-specific regulatory requirements.
Set architecture principles, standards and review processes, and support delivery teams.

Requirements

Principal-level experience in data architecture, information architecture or enterprise architecture within a regulated business.
Experience establishing common information models across multiple markets, business lines or organisations.
Practical experience with domain-driven design (bounded contexts, context maps, domain ownership).
Experience designing and governing large-scale analytical or operational data platforms, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent.
Experience with data migration or CDC from operational systems such as Oracle, Db2 or PostgreSQL.
Experience treating schemas, data contracts and semantic models as versioned engineering artefacts.
Solid understanding of GDPR, DORA and related governance requirements.
Strong ability to build consensus across business and technology teams.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

Experience from Nordic financial services, information services or other regulated data businesses.
Domain knowledge in credit, risk, lending or decisioning.
Modernisation of mainframe, Db2 or Oracle environments.
ML/AI governance, feature stores or model lineage.
Evaluation of public-cloud, sovereign-cloud or hybrid deployment models.
Swedish

Technology landscape

AWS, Amazon S3, CDC from Oracle/Db2/PostgreSQL, SQL, Python, Java/Spring Boot, rules-engine based decisioning, and tooling for metadata, lineage and information governance.

Location

Stockholm, hybrid with remote work as required.

Start:
October/November

jobs.description:

Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.

Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.

Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.

We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.

About The Role

IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer for the team that owns IAR's license management platform. It’s the system that lets customers access and run IAR's software tools, whether through a cloud-based, subscription-ready platform or on-premises. The team works across the full stack, from the client software installed on developers' machines to the services and infrastructure behind it.

As a Software Engineer, you'll take ownership of the license client components used across IAR's product portfolio, while getting exposure to the wider platform and plenty of room to grow in the direction that interests you.

What You’ll Do

Develop and maintain the license client software used across IAR's products to access and validate licenses.
Support and evolve our cloud-based, subscription licensing platform alongside our on-premises offering.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the client and backend services, including occasional work in our license back-office systems.
Collaborate closely with the rest of the team on architecture, priorities, and technical decisions.
Get involved in wider platform work, including web services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

What You Bring to the Table

Professional experience in C++ software development.
Automation and scripting skills in Python or similar languages.
Experience building or integrating web services and APIs.
Comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments.
Experience with containerized development using Docker.
Good communication skills in English.

Bonus Points For...

Exposure to cloud technologies (e.g. Azure), microservices, or Kubernetes.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, Git/GitLab, or Artifactory.
Experience with C# and/or Java, useful for our license back-office and integration services.

Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.

We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.

Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.
Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.
Opportunities to Grow Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.
Inclusive by Design You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.
Rewarding Your Impact Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

Bring Your Whole Self

The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.

jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest-throughput services at the company.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage-format-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission-critical OLTP database platform.
Collaborate with Principal Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read-path caching, and backpressure under load.
Own end-to-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high-throughput services reliable, and participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root-cause resolution.

A day in the life

You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production.

About The Team

Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience in development in the last 3 years
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
Knowledge of databases, storage and big data concepts
Experience with performance and scalability testing

jobs.title: Chief Architect - TradeNet
jobs.description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

How we build

TradeNet is Singapore's National Single Window for trade permit processing. It handles over 9 million permit applications annually and accounts for around 10% of national tax revenues. We are replacing the decades-old legacy system with a modern, cloud-native platform.

The rebuild touches everything: decomposing a monolithic Java/J2EE application into cloud-native services, reconstructing undocumented business logic from incomplete legacy code, clearing compliance and data-governance constraints, and delivering a platform that multiple government agencies depend on daily.

The Chief Architect owns the technical coherence of this effort. You define how the system is structured, how teams interface with each other, and where the hard boundaries are. You work across product squads, TechOps, and programme leadership — but your authority is technical, not managerial.

Teams here use AI-assisted development workflows daily, including LLM/agentic-AI tooling for spec building, code generation, and test automation. You are expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with these tools.

[What you will be working on]

Architecture & technical direction

Set the overall system architecture for the TradeNet platform — service decomposition, data architecture, API contracts, infrastructure patterns.
Make binding technical decisions across teams. Resolve cross-squad technical disputes. Own the architecture decision record.
Design for resilience: fault isolation, blast-radius containment, defensive API contracts, and graceful degradation across a system that cannot go down.
Define the architectural guardrails, contracts, and patterns that teams build on — enabling independent delivery without architectural drift.

Legacy modernisation

Lead the technical strategy for decomposing and replacing the legacy monolith, including where to strangle, where to rewrite, and where to leave alone.
Reconstruct undocumented business logic from incomplete legacy codebases — using source analysis, documentation archaeology, dependency tracing, and AI-assisted reverse-engineering.
Navigate compliance and data-governance constraints that shape what can be migrated, how, and when.

Hands-on technical work

Write architecture documents, design specs, and technical RFCs that teams implement against.
Review code and designs across squads — particularly at integration boundaries and in foundational components.
Prototype and prove out critical technical approaches before committing teams to them.
Lead root-cause analysis on hard production and programme-level technical problems.

AI-assisted engineering

Pioneer and refine AI/LLM-assisted approaches to legacy analysis, code generation, test creation, and documentation.
Set the technical standards for how AI-generated output is evaluated, attributed, and held to quality.
Push the programme's use of agentic AI beyond basic code completion into architectural and analytical workflows.

Technical leadership

Earn trust with engineering teams through technical credibility — you lead by being right and being helpful, not by title. Your authority comes from the quality of your decisions and your willingness to get into the details.
Resolve technical disputes across squads. People will disagree on approach, and you are the one who makes the call and gets buy-in from both sides.
Balance technical debt against migration timelines. Know when to take a shortcut to hit a delivery date and when to say no because the long-term cost is too high. Make these tradeoffs explicitly and visibly.
Grow technical leads across squads. Mentor senior engineers. Raise the bar on technical decision-making across the programme.
Provide technical input to programme-level decisions: sequencing, risk, feasibility, and pivot recommendations.
Secure executive alignment on technical direction, particularly under ambiguity or when course corrections are needed.

[What we are looking for]

At least 12 years of hands-on software engineering, with significant time spent as a principal/staff engineer or architect on large-scale systems (not purely management track).
Experience as the overall technical lead across multiple teams (5+ teams, 40+ engineers) — setting architecture that others build on, without directly managing them.
Deep experience with legacy modernisation: decomposing monoliths, migrating off on-prem platforms, reconstructing business logic from incomplete or undocumented systems. You've done this before and know where it goes wrong.
Strong cloud-native architecture background — service design, event-driven systems, API-first platforms, infrastructure-as-code. Ideally on AWS.
Demonstrated ability to make hard technical calls under ambiguity — pivoting programmes, resolving cross-team disputes, and getting executive buy-in for technical direction when the path isn't clear.
Experience designing defensive/resilient architectures for systems that cannot afford downtime — fault isolation, contract enforcement, blast-radius containment.

Role Summary

We are seeking an AI Deployed Engineer (Agentic) to serve as a forward-deployed engineer on the agentic project team — partnering closely with the customer to build, deploy and operate agentic AI solutions end to end. In this hands-on role you will design and build full-stack systems and AI agents, writing production-grade code to take solutions from first prototype through to stable production, and then support Day 2 operations to keep the Azure platform underpinning the solution healthy, secure and cost-efficient. You will embed with customer teams to understand their needs and guide adoption, leverage SRE agents to automate routine operations, and codify working patterns into reusable tools and playbooks — all within a secure government environment.

Key Responsibilities

Build agentic solutions (software development): Design and build full-stack systems and AI agents, writing production-grade code that takes solutions from first prototype through to stable production.
Embed with the customer: Work closely with customer teams to understand their needs, scope work, sequence delivery, remove blockers early and guide adoption.
Own end-to-end delivery: Own technical delivery across deployments, making trade-offs between scope, speed and quality and adjusting plans to protect delivery.
Codify and share: Turn working solutions into reusable tools, playbooks and building blocks, and share field feedback that helps improve model and product performance.
Azure platform operations: Maintain the Azure platform and virtual machines (including the GitHub server).
Backup and resilience: Perform and verify GitHub server backups, using SRE agents to automate uptime checks and backups where possible.
DevOps and CI/CD: Operate and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines, validating that pipelines continue to work after upgrades.
Container platforms (ACA / ACR): Manage Azure Container Apps and clean up the Azure Container Registry.
App Services and Functions: Update and maintain frameworks for App Services and Function Apps.
Security operations: Pipe logs to Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel, triage and close alerts, and monitor application performance via dashboards (working with developers to pipe crash logs and build dashboards).
• Identity and access (IAM): Review RBAC access for personnel and maintain least-privilege access.
• Cost and support: Produce cost reporting to the customer and monitor support tickets (service requests and issues) through to resolution.

Required Qualifications

Production-grade software development proficiency in Python, JavaScript or comparable stacks, with the ability to contribute directly in code.
Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, agentic AI or generative-AI models.
Experience scoping and delivering complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments, including customer-facing technical delivery.
Hands-on experience operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure platforms in production (Virtual Machines, App Services, Function Apps).
Experience with Azure Container Apps (ACA) and Azure Container Registry (ACR).
Strong DevOps / CI-CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions pipelines.
Experience with Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel for logging, monitoring and security alert handling.
Working knowledge of IAM / RBAC and cloud security best practices.
Experience supporting Day 2 / run-and-maintain operations — patching, backups, incident and ticket handling — with an SRE mindset.
Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, product teams and customer stakeholders, with sound judgement under pressure.
Singapore Citizen who is eligible to obtain and maintain Singapore Government security clearance, and willing to undergo the required MINDEF vetting process.
Willingness to work on-site at client premises, including secured MINDEF facilities, as required.

Performance Evaluation

Performance in this role will be assessed through periodic performance feedback evaluation provided directly by the customer (MINDEF). The successful candidate is expected to consistently meet the customer's quality, delivery, and professionalism standards throughout the engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with agentic AI solutions and using SRE agents to automate operational tasks.
Prior experience working within secured or classified government environments.
Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
Experience with container platforms and cloud-native application deployment on Azure.

What We Offer

The opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI and agentic solutions, delivering and operating mission-critical systems for one of Singapore's most security-conscious public-sector clients. You will join a team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and real-world impact.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer to work hybrid 60% on-site in Belgium or Czech Republic.

TITLE Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)
START DATE 5 Oct 2026
END DATE 5 Mar 2027
LOCATION Kontich, Belgium or Czech Republic
LANGUAGES English
hybrid 60% on-site in

Must have:
Section & platform focus mainly focused on AWS

Advanced Terraform Enterprise/Cloud experience

Demonstrable complex Azure Networking & Governance experience

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

jobs.title: Automation IT Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Automation IT Specialist
to join our global Automation team. This role sits at the intersection of industrial automation (PLC/SCADA) and IT software development, responsible for maintaining and evolving our automation code standards while building next-generation software tools that support automation activities worldwide. The ideal candidate combines strong industrial controls knowledge with modern software development skills, including the application of AI to accelerate automation development.

How You’ll Make An Impact

PLC Standards & Libraries: Understand, maintain, and extend the company's PLC libraries and coding standards, ensuring consistency and quality across automation projects.
SCADA Systems: Work with large-scale SCADA platforms such as System Platform (AVEVA/Wonderware), PCS7, or Ignition, supporting design, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Tool Development: Design and develop new software productivity tools for automation engineering teams, primarily using common IT languages and frameworks.
Legacy Application Maintenance: Maintain and enhance existing internal software tools built on the .NET framework.
Industrial Protocols: Apply hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Modbus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, MQTT) to support integration between automation systems and IT tools.
AI-Enabled Development: Leverage AI tools and techniques (e.g., code generation, implementation acceleration) to improve efficiency and quality of automation software development.
Global Tool Strategy: Develop the next generation of IT tools supporting Automation team activities worldwide, in close collaboration with the Digitalization team.
Cross-Site Collaboration: Partner with automation and digitalization stakeholders across global offices to align tools and standards with site-level needs.

Qualifications

Technical Skills

Solid understanding of PLC programming concepts, libraries, and coding standards
Practical experience with at least one major SCADA platform: System Platform, PCS7, or Ignition
Proficiency in one or more common IT programming languages/frameworks (e.g., C#, VB Script, Python, JavaScript, .NET)
Experience maintaining and developing applications on the .NET framework
Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols
Familiarity with applying AI/LLM tools in an industrial or software development context
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to bridge OT (Operational Technology) and IT domains
Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Active Directory domain environments.
Good communication skills for collaborating with global, cross-functional teams
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects
Willingness to travel internationally to global offices (~20% of time)

Preferred Qualifications

Master Degree in Automation Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
Prior experience in a manufacturing, process, or industrial environment
Experience with digitalization or Industry 4.0 initiatives

What’s In It For You

Opportunity to shape the future of automation tooling across a global organization
Exposure to cutting-edge AI-driven development practices in an industrial setting
Collaborative work with cross-functional digitalization teams
International travel and exposure to diverse manufacturing environments

jobs.description:
The Institute

Technology Innovation Institute (TII) a publicly funded research institute based in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates. It is home to a diverse community of leading scientists, engineers, mathematicians, and researchers from across the globe, transforming problems and roadblocks into pioneering research and technology prototypes that help move society ahead.

Propulsion and Space Research Centre

The digital engineering team within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre develops software and engineering capabilities supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes.
Current capabilities include an operational engineering platform supporting requirements and system models, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization; validated physics and gas-turbine simulation software; an AI engineering assistant grounded in live platform data and operating on local infrastructure; and a growing hardware capability spanning data acquisition, engine telemetry and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
The platform is already operational within an existing deployment. The team’s next phase is focused on establishing product-line standards, enabling versioned components, repeatable releases, multiple deployments and reliable engineering evidence outputs, with the longer-term ambition of developing a commercial-grade offering.
The team operates with direct communication, short decision paths and high individual ownership. Software is developed against real engineering models, test-bench hardware and campaign data, with physics models serving as the technical source of truth.

Role Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer – Simulation & Engineering Products will play a key role in developing and productizing the software backbone supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre.
The role sits within a small digital engineering team responsible for an operational engineering platform, physics-based simulation software, AI-enabled engineering tools, and an expanding hardware and test integration capability.
The successful candidate will be responsible for evolving these capabilities from programme-specific solutions into robust, maintainable and reusable software products built to product-line and commercial-grade standards. This includes establishing repeatable releases, versioned components, reliable deployment processes, stable APIs, test-evidence pipelines, and software that can support multiple programmes and future external applications.

Key Responsibilities
Software Product Engineering

Evolve the existing engineering platform from a single-deployment system into a configurable, maintainable and reusable product capable of supporting multiple programmes and, in the future, external customers.
Develop and enhance backend and frontend capabilities using technologies including Python/FastAPI and React
.
Support platform capabilities covering requirements and system models, including SysML v2
, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization.
Improve overall product quality, including frontend experience, documentation, installation, upgrades, maintainability and security hardening.
Apply a strong product mindset to software architecture and development, considering users, roadmaps, maintainability and total cost of ownership.

CI/CD & Release Engineering

Develop automated build, test and deployment pipelines and comprehensive regression suites.
Establish reliable versioning and release-management practices.
Implement containerized deployments suitable for standard, offline and restricted-network environments.
Develop deployment documentation, operational runbooks and repeatable installation and upgrade processes.
Ensure releases are reliable, controlled and reproducible across deployments.

Numerical & Simulation Software

Support the engineering of physics-based software used as the technical source of truth, including:
Validated gas-turbine performance solvers.
Engine model adaptation using test data.
Compiled real-time engine models.
Extract existing model-adaptation and model-test correlation capabilities into independently versioned libraries with stable APIs.
Enable numerical libraries to be consumed through the platform backend, command-line interfaces and future engineering tools.
Apply appropriate software-engineering practices around scientific and numerical code, including tolerance-based testing, units management and floating-point considerations.
Work closely with physics and model-development specialists to ensure numerical models are integrated and used appropriately.

Test Data & Engineering Evidence

Design and develop pipelines for ingesting engineering and test data using formats including TDMS and HDF5
.
Implement physics-based consistency and validation checks.
Develop traceable and reviewable engineering evidence outputs and reports.
Ensure test results and supporting evidence can be reliably linked to engineering models, requirements and programme activities.

Hardware & Real-Time Integration

Support software integration at the hardware boundary, including data acquisition systems, engine telemetry and real-time targets.
Contribute to the development and integration of a real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL)
test capability.
Support high-rate data logging, time synchronization and reliable data transfer between acquisition systems, real-time systems and the engineering platform.

Engineering Quality & Collaboration

Act as a senior technical reviewer for software, architecture and engineering designs.
Conduct high-quality code reviews, identifying defects, maintainability concerns and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with the platform’s Lead Engineer and other technical specialists within a small, highly autonomous engineering team.
Contribute to establishing and maintaining software-engineering standards across the team.
Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate while maintaining robust human review, testing and evaluation controls.

Research & Publication

Contribute to research and technical publications where the work presents publishable outcomes.
Potential research areas include test-driven model adaptation, evaluation of grounded AI engineering assistants, and test-data engineering.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering
, or a related technical discipline.
Advanced academic qualifications in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline would be advantageous.

Experience

Minimum 7 years of experience building and shipping production-grade software
.

Proven experience owning software through the full development lifecycle, including deployment, operation, maintenance and support.

new_jobs.description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Senior Software Engineer - Flight Data Analysis Software

Uxbridge, West London, 4 days onsite, 1 day from home

Every commercial flight records thousands of parameters — control inputs, engine performance, altitude, warnings. When the aircraft lands, that data has to be retrieved, decoded and turned into something an airline's safety team can act on. We build the software that does it. Over 300 airlines use our ground systems, including most of the world's major carriers, alongside military operators. When an airline spots an unstable approach trend before it becomes an incident, our software is usually how they found it.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team in Uxbridge that builds it.

What you'll actually do

You'll Own Features End To End — From Design Discussion Through To Release — Across a Stack That Spans a Mature .NET Backend, Angular Front Ends, And Python Tooling. Specifically

Design and build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of flight data, where performance and correctness genuinely matter
Take technical ownership of a product area: make the architectural calls, and be the person the team asks about it
Review other engineers' code and mentor two or three developers earlier in their careers
Work with QA, product and the engineering lead across a normal Agile cycle — planning, standups, reviews, retros
Help us modernise: we have a long-lived .NET codebase with some older Windows service components, and part of this role is bringing it forward sensibly rather than rewriting for its own sake

What we need

Around 4+ years building production software commercially
Strong C#/.NET and solid relational database skills (we use MySQL)
Comfortable working across the stack — you don't have to be a front-end specialist, but you should be able to work in TypeScript/Angular when a feature needs it
Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs
Genuinely good at debugging: the ability to work out why a system is misbehaving from incomplete information
Git and modern version control workflows

Useful, but we'll teach you

Python
AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS)
Docker and CI/CD pipelines
Automated testing frameworks
Aviation or aerospace domain knowledge — almost nobody arrives with this, and we don't expect you to

You do not need to tick every box. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, apply.

What we offer

As part of the wider Teledyne UK group, we offer our employees a range of company benefits that include:

Salary sacrifice-led pension plan that matches employee contributions up to 7%.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Free life assurance cover at the value of four times basic annual salary.
⁠Salary sacrifice Electric & Hybrid Vehicle car scheme
25 days holiday per annum, plus bank holidays.
Holiday purchase scheme which enables employees to purchase an additional 5 days worth of annual leave each year.
Company funded medical cash plan (MediCash) which allows eligible members to offset the cost of routine medical treatments.
Internal reward and recognition scheme linked to internal benefits platform.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Comprehensive wellbeing programme that supports employees with their physical, mental and financial health, as well as their cultural/environmental wellbeing.
Competitive employee discounts platform that provides employees with discounts with leading brands/retailers.
Cycle to Work scheme.
Enhanced family-friendly benefits and policies.
Company sick pay.
Free Onsite parking
Career development across the wider Teledyne group — a lot of our engineers have moved between teams, sites and disciplines
Software that matters: what you ship affects how safely aircraft are operated

The commute, honestly

We're onsite four days a week with one day from home. We know that rules us out for some people. But if you live anywhere in West London, Hillingdon, Buckinghamshire or along the M4/M40, this is likely the shortest commute you'll find for a role at this level — Uxbridge is the end of the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, and there's parking. Several of our team took this job specifically to stop commuting into central London.

Interview process

A Teams call with the hiring manager and site manager — informal, both ways
An onsite session covering technical discussion and a paired programming task, plus competency-based questions with our Head of Digital Solutions
Offer

About Teledyne Controls

Since 1964 we've designed and manufactured aircraft data recording and management systems, working directly with airlines and with OEMs including Airbus and Boeing. Teledyne Controls Flight Data Company in Uxbridge is our principal UK office, where we develop the ground-based software used to replay and analyse recorded flight data.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
L'opportunité

Développer la plateforme Unity consiste à concevoir, bâtir, tester et maintenir les systèmes qui permettent aux développeur(se)s de livrer et d'exploiter des jeux en direct à grande échelle. L'équipe Diagnostics fait partie de l'organisation LiveOps de Unity et est responsable des données qui indiquent aux créateur(rice)s comment leurs jeux se comportent réellement sur le terrain : rapports de plantage du runtime Unity, télémétrie et observabilité à travers les projets clients, analyses de la santé des produits, ainsi que les surfaces du Tableau de bord Unity qui redonnent ces données aux développeur(se)s.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) logiciel Sénior pour se joindre à l'équipe Diagnostics en tant que généraliste à dominante backend. Il/elle va diriger la conception de bout en bout à travers notre pile — ingestion depuis des millions de clients de jeux, Pipelines bâtis sur OpenTelemetry, un lac de données basé sur ClickHouse, et les surfaces de tableau de bord dont dépendent les client(e)s — et collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data, IAP, Profiler et DevX sur les intégrations qui rendent Diagnostics réellement utile. Notre pile est composée de Go (principalement), Kotlin, TypeScript et C#. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe autonome où le jugement sénior a un impact exponentiel : il/elle va définir la manière dont l'équipe conçoit, révise et livre ses solutions, y compris la façon dont nous utilisons les outils d'IA agentique comme partie intégrante de notre pratique de développement.

Ce que vous allez faire

Diriger la conception de bout en bout pour l'ingestion, les Pipelines, le stockage et les requêtes ClickHouse, ainsi que les tableaux de bord sur lesquels les développeur(se)s s'appuient.
Rédiger et maintenir des services Go de haute qualité capables de gérer à grande échelle des entrées contrôlées par des acteurs malveillants, avec une attention particulière à la fiabilité, à la performance et à la clarté des contrats de données.
Rehausser les standards de revue de code et de revue de résultats assistés par l'IA — définir les normes utilisées par l'équipe lorsqu'elle livre des travaux en collaboration avec des agents de codage.
Collaborer avec les différentes équipes (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) afin de concevoir des intégrations robustes en conditions de production et adaptées aux besoins réels des client(e)s.
Encadrer les développeur(se)s de l'équipe, partager largement les bons modèles, et décomposer des problèmes ambigus en parcours concrets maximisant la valeur.

Ce que nous recherchons

Avoir une expérience en production avec Go dans des services à haut débit, ainsi qu'une aisance sur un large éventail de tâches backend (ingestion, Pipelines, stockage et requêtes OLAP/colonnaires, tableaux de bord au besoin).
Démontrer un jugement de niveau sénior : avoir mené des conceptions transversales, rehaussé le niveau de développement, et mentoré les pairs et collaborateur(rice)s individuel(le)s autour de soi.
Posséder une réelle expérience pratique des flux de travail avec IA agentique : avoir utilisé des agents de codage (Claude Code, Codex, mode agent de Cursor, Gemini CLI ou équivalent) sur du travail concret, développé une opinion éclairée sur leurs compromis, et conçu des harnais, prompts ou sous-agents robustes face à la variance. Revoir les sorties de modèles avec la même rigueur que des revues de PR, et être capable de défendre chaque ligne de code en ses propres mots.
Avoir de l'expérience en conception et en interrogation de magasins de données NoSQL ou OLAP/colonnaires (ClickHouse est un atout), ainsi qu'une compréhension pratique de bout en bout des Pipelines de données.
Posséder d'excellentes aptitudes de collaboration et de communication, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs équipes et fuseaux horaires.

Vous avez peut-être également

Manifester un intérêt sincère ou une expérience en observabilité et télémétrie (OpenTelemetry en particulier) — c'est notre cœur de métier.
Avoir une expérience front-end avec TypeScript et des contributions à des surfaces de type tableau de bord. Le backend est la priorité pour ce rôle; les compétences front-end sont un atout bienvenu, sans être une attente quotidienne.
Avoir une expérience en production avec Kotlin, ou une exposition à C# du côté du moteur.
Posséder un parcours dans le domaine du jeu vidéo — comprendre comment les développeur(se)s consomment les diagnostics, et ce que la performance et le profilage d'un jeu signifient concrètement pour eux/elles.
Adopter des habitudes responsables dans la gestion des données des utilisateur(rice)s : tenir compte des frontières de confiance, de la rétention, de la journalisation hygiénique (aucune donnée personnelle identifiable, aucun jeton, aucun contenu complet de charge utile) et de la modélisation des menaces avant d'implémenter une fonctionnalité.

Information supplémentaire

Le support à la relocalisation n'est pas disponible pour ce poste
Un visa de travail ou un parrainage de l'immigration n'est pas disponible pour ce poste

The opportunity

Developing the Unity platform means designing, building, testing, and maintaining the systems that empower developers to ship and operate live games at scale. The Diagnostics team sits inside Unity's LiveOps umbrella and is responsible for the data that tells creators how their games are actually behaving in the wild — crash reports from the Unity runtime, telemetry and observability across customer projects, product health analysis, and the Unity Dashboard surfaces that put that data back in developers' hands.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Diagnostics team as a backend-leaning generalist. You will lead end-to-end design across our stack — ingest from millions of game clients, pipelines built on OpenTelemetry, a ClickHouse-based data lake, and the dashboard surfaces customers depend on — and you will partner closely with the Data, IAP, Profiler, and DevX teams on the integrations that make Diagnostics useful. Our stack is Go (primary), Kotlin, TypeScript, and C#. This is a small, autonomous team where senior judgment compounds: you will shape how the team designs, reviews, and ships, including how we work with agentic AI tools as a core part of the craft.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead end-to-end design across ingest, pipelines, ClickHouse storage and query, and the dashboards developers rely on.
Write and maintain high-quality Go services that handle attacker-controlled inputs at scale, with strong attention to reliability, performance, and clean data contracts.
Raise the bar on code review and AI-assisted output review — set the norms the team uses when shipping work alongside coding agents.
Partner across teams (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) to design integrations that hold up under real production load and real customer needs.
Mentor engineers across the team, share patterns broadly, and decompose ambiguous problems into the highest-value path forward.

What We're Looking For

Production experience with Go in high-throughput services, plus comfort moving across a backend-leaning generalist surface (ingest, pipelines, OLAP/columnar storage and query, dashboards when needed).
Demonstrated senior-level judgment: a track record of leading cross-cutting design, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring peers and ICs around you.
Real, hands-on fluency with agentic AI workflows — you have used coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Gemini CLI, or similar) on real work, formed informed opinions about their trade-offs, and built harnesses, prompts, or sub-agents that hold up under variance. You review model output as rigorously as PR code, and can defend any line of it in your own words.
Experience designing for and querying NoSQL or OLAP/columnar data stores (ClickHouse a plus), and a working understanding of data pipelines end to end.
Excellent collaboration and communication, with the ability to work effectively across teams and time zones.

You might also have

Genuine interest or experience in observability and telemetry (OpenTelemetry especially) — this is our bread and butter.
Front-end experience with TypeScript and contributions to dashboard-style surfaces. Backend is the primary lens for this role; front-end capability is a welcome bonus, not a daily expectation.
Production experience with Kotlin, or C# exposure on the engine side.
Gaming background — context for how developers consume diagnostics, what game performance and profiling actually mean to them.
Habits around handling user data responsibly: thinking about trust boundaries, retention, hygienic logging (no PII, no tokens, no full payloads), and threat-modeling features before writing them.

Additional Information

Relocation support is not available for this position
Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

Avantages

Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

Veuillez noter: L’admissibilité aux avantages, les offres spécifiques et la couverture varient selon le pays et le statut d’emploi.

Bien que les avantages précis puissent varier, voici certaines des façons dont nous nous efforçons de prendre soin de nos membres d’équipe admissibles à l’échelle mondiale : assurance santé, vie et invalidité complète | Subvention pour les déplacements | Participation des employés à l’actionnariat | Régimes de retraite/pension compétitifs | Vacances et congés personnels généreux | Soutien aux nouveaux parents grâce à des congés et des programmes de soutien aux familles | Collations offertes au bureau | Programmes et soutien en matière de santé mentale et de bien-être | Groupes-ressources pour employés | Programme mondial d’aide aux employés | Programmes de formation et de perfectionnement | Programme de bénévolat et de jumelage de dons

La vie chez Unity

Unity [NYSE : U] est le premier moteur de jeu au monde, propulsant les expériences de plus de 3 milliards d’utilisateurs(rices) chaque mois. Les plus grands jeux mobiles, les titres indépendants PC les plus populaires, des jeux console parmi les plus innovants, ainsi que la quasi-totalité des principales expériences XR et jeux Web sont développés, déployés et optimisés avec Unity.

Unity accompagne également des équipes dans des secteurs tels que l’automobile, l’industrie manufacturière et la santé pour concevoir, simuler et collaborer en 3D - comblant ainsi l’écart entre les idées et la réalité. Pour plus d’informations, veuillez visiter www.unity.com.

Unity est un employeur fier de garantir l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif et innovateur et à célébrer nos employés à travers l’âge, l’éthinicité, la couleur, l’ascendance, l’origine nationale, la religion, le handicap, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle ou tout autre statut protégé conformément à la loi applicable. Si vous êtes en situation de handicap ou avez des besoins spécifiques nécessitant des aménagements pour que votre entretien se déroule dans les meilleures conditions, nous vous invitons à remplir ce formulaire afin de nous en informer et que nous puissions faire le nécessaire.
