new_jobs.title: CRM Developer – Dynamics 365 (M/F/NB)
new_jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy biznesowe. Wspieramy naszych klientów w tworzeniu i rozwoju systemów IT, które są stabilne, skalowalne i dopasowane do rzeczywistych potrzeb użytkowników. Pracujemy blisko biznesu, stawiając na jakość inżynierską, odpowiedzialność i partnerską współpracę.

O zespole i projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego rozwiązanie oparte o Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
, w którym system CRM stanowi kluczowy element większego ekosystemu integrującego różne procesy i systemy biznesowe. To projekt o mocno developerskim charakterze. Na co dzień będziesz rozwijać zarówno warstwę kliencką, jak i serwerową Dynamics 365 CRM, tworząc własne rozszerzenia, logikę biznesową oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi. Zespół pracuje zgodnie z dobrymi praktykami inżynierskimi, dbając o jakość kodu, czytelność rozwiązań i ich dalszy rozwój.

Dlaczego warto?

To rola, w której:

rozwijasz Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM od strony developerskiej, a nie wyłącznie konfiguracyjnej,
pracujesz zarówno z TypeScript, jak i C#/.NET, rozwijając logikę po stronie klienta i serwera,
tworzysz pluginy, customizacje oraz integracje z systemami zewnętrznymi,
wykorzystujesz Azure Service Bus do komunikacji pomiędzy systemami,
masz realny wpływ na jakość rozwiązań i sposób ich implementacji.

Jeśli lubisz projekty, w których możesz rozwijać oprogramowanie, pracować z kodem i mieć wpływ na architekturę rozwiązania, ta rola będzie dobrym wyborem.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój client-side customizacji w Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM z wykorzystaniem TypeScript, w tym logiki formularzy, walidacji oraz obsługi elementów interfejsu,
rozwój pluginów C#/.NET odpowiedzialnych za logikę biznesową i customizacje encji,
implementację logiki obsługującej zdarzenia Create, Update i Delete,
rozwój integracji pomiędzy Dynamics 365 CRM a systemami zewnętrznymi z wykorzystaniem Azure Service Bus,
współpracę przy wdrożeniach aplikacji z wykorzystaniem wewnętrznych procesów CI/CD oraz narzędzi opartych o Power Apps,
dbanie o jakość kodu oraz stosowanie dobrych praktyk programistycznych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz komercyjne doświadczenie w rozwoju Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM,
bardzo dobrze znasz C#/.NET oraz TypeScript / JavaScript,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu client-side customizacji formularzy Dynamics 365 CRM,
rozwijałeś/aś pluginy Dynamics 365 CRM oraz logikę biznesową po stronie serwera,
masz doświadczenie w integracji systemów z wykorzystaniem API lub kolejek komunikatów,
potrafisz pracować samodzielnie i brać odpowiedzialność za rozwijane rozwiązania,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z Azure Service Bus,
znajomość usług Microsoft Azure,
doświadczenie z Power Platform (Power Apps lub Power Automate),
znajomość procesów CI/CD oraz pracy z Git.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz dzielenie się wiedzą w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i budowanie indywidualnej ścieżki rozwoju podczas regularnych spotkań z menedżerem/menedżerką,
benefity, takie jak prywatna opieka medyczna Medicover, karta Multisport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie, dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczność w zakresie godzin pracy i formy współpracy oraz możliwość korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku,
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych, wydarzeniach wewnętrznych i społecznościach tematycznych.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i zobaczymy, jak pasuje do tej roli i projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – luźna, partnerska rozmowa (ok. 40–60 minut), żeby lepiej się poznać, porozmawiać o Twojej drodze zawodowej, motywacji i oczekiwaniach.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) – spotkanie z osobami z zespołu projektowego, podczas którego porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu programistycznym, realizowanych projektach oraz podejściu do rozwiązywania problemów technicznych.
Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Nasza firma wdrożyła procedury ochrony sygnalistów zgodnie z obowiązującą ustawą. Każda osoba ma prawo zgłaszać nieprawidłowości w bezpieczny sposób, a zgłoszenia są objęte pełną ochroną prawną. Więcej informacji: https://www.etteplan.com/pl/kodeks-postepowania/

new_jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer — SaaS Platform & Cross-Product Architecture
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

What You'll Do

Own technical decision-making for the teams you support: evaluate technology options, run POCs and benchmarks, and make evidence-based recommendations on frameworks, datastores, and infrastructure —including partition strategies, migration plans, and performance validation at SaaS scale
Shape platform-level architecture: Kubernetes (AKS) deployment topology, Kafka-based messaging, durable workflow orchestration, and multi-tenant data models
Serve as an embedded architecture partner for .NET product teams: review technical designs, code, author/critique RFCs, guide teams through scalability and cloud-readiness problems, and help converge products toward shared platform standards
Mentor engineers across teams and raise the bar on engineering standards (GitOps, golden pipelines, observability, supply-chain security)
Assess established on-premises products for scaling, performance, resiliency, code quality, technology choices, supported environments, interoperability, security, and third-party dependencies, and define a realistic migration path to SaaS that does not disrupt on-premises delivery
Partner with Product Management, Support, and Professional Services to ground architecture recommendations in real customer and field issues, and review findings with those teams before publishing
Produce architecture artifacts — C4 diagrams, RFCs, design reviews, benchmarks — and present trade-offs to engineering leadership
Design, build, and improve microservices and backend systems for the SaaS platform using related technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, JDK 21+, and .NET. Follow sound cloud-native development principles, including API-first design, resilience patterns, and comprehensive unit, integration, and performance testing.
Turn recurring solutions into shared libraries, tooling, and examples that other teams can adopt.
Use AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, and design exploration. Review generated code with the same care as any other contribution, including correctness, security, and maintainability.

Skills And Experience

10+ years in software engineering, with a track record of technical leadership
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring ecosystem)
Hands-on experience with C#/.NET and sound architectural judgment, with the ability to review designs and code, provide design guidance, and help product teams address scalability and cloud-readiness challenges.
Working familiarity with Active Directory and Entra ID: domain services, LDAP, authentication protocols, and directory data models, with the appetite to go deeper
Comfortable reasoning about Windows-centric on-premises products (agents, domain controllers, customer-installed footprints) and the constraints of dual on-premises and SaaS delivery
Production Kubernetes experience: service design, Helm/GitOps deployment, jobs, autoscaling, multi-tenant SaaS operations
Comfortable with distributed-data fundamentals: partitioning, consistency trade-offs, high-volume ingestion/ETL, query performance tuning; hands-on with a relational database at scale (PostgreSQL, SQL Server or similar), plus exposure to at least one analytical or NoSQL store
Event-driven architecture experience (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar), API-first design, and modern resilience/observability practices
Good documentation skills — comfortable producing RFCs and design docs and influencing teams you don't manage

Nice to have

Go, Azure, workflow engines (e.g. Temporal)
Experience with Spring Reactive
Exposure to identity security, such as ITDR, privileged access management, or identity governance

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

Competitive Health Benefits
Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

Pracujemy projektowo – w zależności od etapu wdrożenia możesz uczestniczyć zarówno w rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, integracji systemów, rolloutach, upgrade’ach, jak i uruchomieniach produkcyjnych.

new_jobs.title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.

We're looking for an experienced AI-First Senior Software Engineer
for our Stockholm office.

This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software engineers , not software developers . AI has hyper-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.

Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and sustainable software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

What You'll Do

System design. Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
Domain modelling. Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the right solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
Architectural patterns. Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
Process design — the core responsibility. Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as orchestrator–worker (an orchestrator decides sub-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and evaluator–optimizer (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
Quality judgment. Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line-by-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
Tooling — the right tool for the job. Fluency across product-development tools, AI-acceleration (code-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
Accountability. You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

Your profile

8+ years of hands-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
An early adopter of AI-first development, with proven, in-production experience implementing AI-first software development processes — not just experimenting with tooling
Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow-vs-agent decisions)
Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
Test design, feedback-loop design and validation skills over line-by-line review
Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI-accelerated pipelines
Infrastructure / CI-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
Domain-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Tools you'll work with

AI-acceleration: Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
Languages & engineering: .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code-review practice
Workflow orchestration: agent frameworks and multi-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
Infrastructure: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
Quality control: automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI-assisted output

Meritorious

Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
Experience standing up AI-first processes at team or organisation scale
LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience

What this role is not

It is not a prompt-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase less reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail-over and redundancy, because AI burn-out is real)
Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

With us you get

A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

Selected benefits

Opportunity for part-ownership
Competitive fixed salary
30 days holiday
Company laptop, phone and subscription

Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.

Engineering judgement, accelerated — that's how we make IT easy.

emagine is looking for a Principal Data Architect for our client in the financial and information services sector. new_jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest-throughput services at the company.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage-format-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission-critical OLTP database platform.
Collaborate with Principal Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read-path caching, and backpressure under load.
Own end-to-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high-throughput services reliable, and participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root-cause resolution.

A day in the life

You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production.

About The Team

Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience in development in the last 3 years
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large-scale systems
Knowledge of databases, storage and big data concepts
Experience with performance and scalability testing

Job Description

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Job Summary

The AI Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing secure, scalable and cost-efficient AI architectures for APAC deployments. The role defines technical standards, patterns and guardrails across models, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure and security layers, ensuring solutions align with global governance while meeting APAC data sovereignty and regulatory requirements. The role provides technical direction to the team, supporting the design, build, maintenance and continuous improvement of advanced AI and automation solutions. This is a 3-year fixed term contract for placement in Singapore, and only open to SG/PR candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Design & Standards

Design scalable, secure and cost-efficient AI system architectures for regional deployments.
Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns and architectural guardrails for the team.
Lead build vs buy vs integrate decisions, evaluating platforms and vendors.
Produce architecture artefacts (solution designs, data flows, integration maps, technical roadmaps).

Cloud & Infrastructure

Architect solutions across relevant cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and compliant options as required).
Design for multi-cloud and hybrid environments where regulations demand.
Ensure infrastructure meets data sovereignty requirements across APAC countries.
Review cloud cost architecture to balance performance and spend.
Ensure AI development and deployment environments are designed for reliability, reproducibility, access control and operational support.

AI Platform & Model Strategy

Designs and governs AI and machine learning environments, including patterns for experimentation, deployment, monitoring and operational support.
Evaluate and select foundational models, fine-tuning approaches and RAG architectures appropriate to each use case.
Design MLOps and LLMOps pipelines (model versioning, evaluation, monitoring, retraining triggers).
Define the regional AI platform strategy (shared services, reusable components, integration patterns).
Stay current on model developments and assess architectural implications for the roadmap.

Security & Governance

Embed security controls (encryption, access controls, audit logging) into all architectural decisions.
Align architecture to global governance standards and partner with security and risk stakeholders.
Conduct technical risk assessments for new AI initiatives and define mitigation architecture.

Requirements

Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/AI, or equivalent experience)
Working experience 8+ years - Experience in solution, software, data or enterprise architecture
Experience using data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, or data warehouses to discover, analyse, and prepare governed datasets for advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases.
Proficiency in SQL and Python for data access, analysis, and preparation.
Ability to work effectively with large datasets, apply data quality and governance standards, and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Understanding of security-by-design, privacy-by-design, data governance, and access control

Nice-to-have

Understanding of AI solution patterns; RAG, model integration, agentic workflows, and secure enterprise deployment
Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure data services or comparable lakehouse/data platforms
MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management or AI evaluation frameworks
API design, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code
Vector databases, semantic search, fine-tuning or generative AI evaluation
Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry or related Microsoft AI service
Relevant certifications in Azure, AI, Databricks, or AWS
Management experience 2+ years - Experience providing technical leadership in collaborative or agile delivery environments, including guiding team members on solution design, engineering standards, maintainability and delivery quality.
AI & IT expertise - Proven experience sponsoring AI & IT initiatives, data driven platforms, IT transformation, and automation at scale.
Other experience - Strong business acumen, financial management, risk governance, and experience operating in APAC multicultural environments.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer to work hybrid 60% on-site in Belgium or Czech Republic.

TITLE Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)
START DATE 5 Oct 2026
END DATE 5 Mar 2027
LOCATION Kontich, Belgium or Czech Republic
LANGUAGES English
hybrid 60% on-site in

Must have:
Section & platform focus mainly focused on AWS

Advanced Terraform Enterprise/Cloud experience

Demonstrable complex Azure Networking & Governance experience

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.
